title: Quercetin Dihydrate 95% – Evolutionary.org
abstract:
## Introduction  
You have probably **heard the term 'superfood' on health-tv programs or on social media**. They like to sound clever with some new discovery they pulled out of thin air and they promise things like longevity, organ health, immune system boost, and better endurance. The truth is superfoods are right under our noses in foods we can eat like kale and berries, but they aren't from the actual food, it is from the compounds they contain. One compound you never heard of is called **Quercetin and it is sold in supplement form as Quercetin Dihydrate**.
## What is it?  
Quercetin Dihydrate is a potent antioxidant flavonoid that is in certain colorful fruits and vegetables. Interestingly enough those colorful foods are like that because **Quercetin is plant pigment that gives things like berries, greens, and broccoli** their different colors. It is a major fighter of free radicals in the body which suppress cancer, [aging and inflammation](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC6457053/#:~:text=One%20of%20the%20major%20changes,inflammation%20and%20the%20immunosenescence%20process.) and you should not only be making sure you eat plenty of foods that contain it but also supplement with it too.
